name: Client Meeting (Me / Client actions)
description: Concise notes with action items split between me and the client.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Three to five sentences on the purpose of the meeting and what was decided

sections.title: Key Points
sections.instruction: Only the important points: decisions, requirements, numbers, dates and open questions. Skip small talk

sections.title: My Action Items
sections.instruction: Tasks I (the person recording) committed to or was asked to do, with due date if mentioned

sections.title: Client Action Items
sections.instruction: Tasks the client committed to or that we are waiting on from the client, with owner and due date if mentioned

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: Unresolved questions and who needs to answer them
